summary: E2E test of the Branding Manager (Gestor de Marca) feature for the Super Admin. Validated UI flows (upload, activate, delete, 5/cat limit, counters), public reflection on /auth and / landing, and dynamic favicon. All 7 requested test scenarios pass.

test_results_detailed.1_tab_visible_3_sections_counters_0_5: PASS - data-testid='branding-manager' renders 3 sections (favicon, landing, login), each shows '0/5' and a 'Subir' button.
test_results_detailed.2_upload_first_login_png_activates_autom: PASS - Counter 1/5, badge 'Activa' visible on the first item, item marked with emerald border.
test_results_detailed.3_upload_second_and_activate_moves_activ: PASS - Counter 2/5; clicking branding-activate-{id2} moved active state to image #2 only (single active per category).
test_results_detailed.4_delete_image_removes_and_decrements_co: PASS - branding-delete-{id} confirmed via window.confirm autoaccept; thumbnail disappears, counter decrements.
test_results_detailed.5_limit_5_disables_upload_button: PASS - On reaching 5/5 the branding-upload-btn-login received the 'disabled' attribute and class 'cursor-not-allowed' (verified programatically).
test_results_detailed.6_login_logo_reflected_on_/auth_landing_: PASS - In fresh incognito context, /auth uses src='/api/branding/file/{id}' for the active login asset; / landing uses '/api/branding/file/{id}' for active landing asset (test_logo3.png in iteration 1).
test_results_detailed.7_public_GET_/api/branding/active_no_aut: PASS - 200 OK without Authorization header. Returns {favicon, landing, login} with URLs of currently-active assets. Dynamic favicon swap on / verified (link[rel=icon] href changes to /api/branding/file/{id}?t=...).

critical_code_review_comments: branding.py uses an in-process _file_cache dict (module-level). In a multi-worker uvicorn deployment, the cache is per-worker; first request after upload from a different worker will hit Object Storage and warm its own cache - acceptable but worth noting.

_storage_key is also module-level / not protected by a lock. With multiple concurrent requests after expiry, several threads may re-init concurrently. Minor; Emergent storage init should be idempotent.
ALLOWED_CT advertises SVG but the front-end UI text only mentions 'PNG, JPG, WEBP o ICO (máx. 3MB)'. Acceptable but inconsistent.
_public() exposes 'url' as '/api/branding/file/{id}' (relative path). Frontend wraps with brandingFileUrl(); fine. No PII / no _id leakage.
seed_data_creation: All test branding assets uploaded during the run were deleted via DELETE /api/branding/{id} at the end of each script.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding Manager is feature-complete and integrated end-to-end. UI: /admin/super → tab 'Marca / Logos'. Data-testids: branding-manager, branding-section-{cat}, branding-upload-btn-{cat}, branding-input-{cat} (hidden file input -> use set_input_files), branding-item-{id}, branding-activate-{id}, branding-delete-{id}. Public endpoint GET /api/branding/active is unauthenticated. AuthPage uses fetchActiveBranding to override loginLogo, LandingPage swaps the hero logo, App.js swaps favicon. Note: when verifying /auth reflection, use a FRESH browser context (incognito) because authenticated users are redirected away from /auth to /dashboard.
